candidate.title: Eventual periodicity in Queneau's greedy sequence
candidate.statement: From a finite increasing positive-integer seed, repeatedly append the least larger integer not expressible as the sum of two distinct earlier terms. Are the successive gaps eventually periodic?
candidate.status_basis: Green's author-maintained collection, last updated December 2025, poses this target at Problem 7, comments on Queneau's variant. This separately stated greedy variant requires distinct summands; it is not the unique-representation Ulam rule. The numbered entry and local updates were inspected on 2026-10-14; the source date alone does not establish present openness.

attempt_scope: Exactly two positive seeds f<g, strict sums of different actual earlier terms; no arbitrary finite-seed resolution is claimed.
